While these improved safety protocols, the clue omits staffing shortages (Clue 6), suggesting overburdened workers may struggle to sustain these adaptations long-term. Topic: Legacy of Ebola on COVID-19 Response

The conflation of Ebola and COVID-19 due to shared symptoms (Clue 4) led to overcaution among health workers, mirroring Ebola’s stigmatization. Unlike Ebola’s high fatality rate (Clue 7), the lower mortality of COVID-19 (Clue 7) could reduce urgency for public compliance, yet fear persists due to Ebola’s legacy, illustrating a mixed legacy of preparedness and paralysis.
